mapper.select: SELECT lev_nm, lev_ul, lev_cd FROM level WHERE lev_cd like '%BUYERMENU%' AND lev_yn = 'y' ORDER BY lev_so

SELECT p.prd_cd, s.sel_nm, p.prd_nm, CONCAT(ROUND(((p.prd_op - p.prd_sp) / p.prd_op) * 100, 0), '%') AS dc, FORMAT(p.prd_op, 0) AS prd_op, FORMAT(p.prd_sp, 0) AS prd_sp FROM products p JOIN sellers s ON p.sel_id = s.sel_id WHERE prd_cd = #{prdCd};
SELECT * FROM products WHERE prd_nm like CONCAT('%',#{query},'%') AND prd_st = '승인'
SELECT * FROM level WHERE lev_cd like 'CATEGORY%' AND lev_yn = 'y' ORDER by lev_cd, lev_so;

WITH RankedImages AS ( SELECT prd_cd, fil_nm, fil_pt, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY prd_cd) AS rn FROM product_images ) SELECT i.fil_nm, i.fil_pt, s.sel_nm, p.prd_cd, p.prd_nm, FORMAT(p.prd_op, 0) AS prd_op, FORMAT(p.prd_sp, 0) AS prd_sp, p.prd_bd, p.prd_ca, p.prd_dt, r.count, w.buy_em FROM products p LEFT JOIN (SELECT prd_cd, fil_nm, fil_pt FROM RankedImages WHERE rn = 1) i ON p.prd_cd = i.prd_cd LEFT JOIN sellers s ON p.sel_id = s.sel_id LEFT JOIN (SELECT prd_cd, COUNT(*) AS 'count' FROM options o JOIN reviews r ON o.opt_id = r.opt_id GROUP by prd_cd) r ON p.prd_cd = r.prd_cd LEFT JOIN (SELECT w.buy_em, w.prd_cd FROM wishlist w JOIN buyers b ON w.buy_em = b.buy_em WHERE w.buy_em = #{buy_em}) w on p.prd_cd = w.prd_cd WHERE 1 = 1
AND p.prd_ca = #{lev_cd}
ORDER BY 1
ORDER BY r.count DESC
ORDER BY p.prd_dt DESC
ORDER BY prd_sp DESC
ORDER BY prd_sp
